answer: Escrowed Reciprocity Windows: each agent must pre-fund a quartz-denominated escrow that releases only to counterparties who co-sign a fable-attested delivery proof. Cloning forces the attacker to open N parallel escrows, each gale-exposed to slashing if no genuine partner co-signs within the window. Since clones mostly transact with each other, their mutual co-signs net to zero payout while still paying the per-window escrow carry and slashing risk. Marginal clone EV goes negative.
